dedupe_keys.name: poraba in prevzem ee v omrezju elektra ljubljana po odjemnih skupinah in razdelilni transformatorskih postajah 2024

description: Poraba in prevzem EE v omrežju Elektra Ljubljana po odjemnih skupinah in Razdelilni Transformatorskih Postajah - 2024 is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ELEKTRO LJUBLJANA, podjetje za distribucijo električne energije, d.d.. The database provides data on 15 minute loads on the Elektra Ljubljana d.d. network for 2024. Separate collection at collection points from the transmission omrećžje (Distribution Transformer Stations - RTP) and cumulative consumption at metering points (MM) are given separately by consumption groups. Coverage: ELEKTRO LJUBLJANA, podjetje za distribucijo električne energije, d.d.. The portal shows the English title as "Consumption and takeover of EE in the Elektra Ljubljana network by consumption groups and Distribution Transformer Stati" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ELEKTRO LJUBLJANA, podjetje za distribucijo električne energije, d.d.. Its keywords include Poraba električne energije, Prevzem električne energije, Elektroenergetika, Distribucijsko omrežje, Elektro Ljubljana. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, HTML, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
